    The Euler form of a directed algebra is a unit form #

    The inverse of the Cartan matrix is again unitriangular (cartan_inv_diag), so the symmetrized Euler form c_ab = ⟨e_a, e_b⟩ + ⟨e_b, e_a⟩ has c_aa = 2 and defines a unit form eulerForm whose value is the Euler quadratic form ⟨x, x⟩ (eulerForm_val).
